title: AI and Machine Learning
content: NovaSkill Academy offers a six-month AI and Machine Learning course for INR 25000. It covers Python, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, RAG and practical projects. Basic programming knowledge is recommended.

title: Data Science
content: The Data Science course costs INR 30000 and lasts six months. It covers Python, SQL, statistics, data visualization and predictive analytics.

title: Full Stack Development
content: The Full Stack Development course costs INR 20000 and lasts four months. It covers HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, databases and deployment.

title: Python Programming
content: The Python Programming course costs INR 10000 and lasts two months. No previous programming experience is required.

title: Cloud Computing
content: The Cloud Computing course costs INR 22000 and lasts four months. It covers AWS, Docker, networking, CI/CD and cloud deployment.

title: Payment Options
content: Students can pay in full or request an installment plan through an admissions counsellor. Discounts are subject to approval.

title: Placement Assistance
content: NovaSkill Academy provides resume guidance, mock interviews and career mentoring. Employment and salary outcomes are not guaranteed.

title: Class Timings
content: Online weekday and weekend batches are available depending on demand. Exact schedules are confirmed by admissions counsellors.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refund eligibility depends on the enrollment agreement and course commencement date. Contact an admissions counsellor for confirmation.

title: Admissions Consultation
content: NovaSkill Academy offers free 30-minute admissions consultations. Appointments are subject to counsellor availability.
